about.title: About the CMS Calendar
about.content: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools serves Mecklenburg County and publishes several academic calendars. This site uses the CMS Traditional Calendar as the default district calendar, while CPCC early colleges and middle colleges, UNC Charlotte early colleges, Hawthorne Academy of Health Sciences, and A/B day schedules have separate official calendars. Families should confirm which calendar their school follows before using dates for childcare, transportation, appointments, or travel.

compareIntro: North Carolina districts publish separate local calendars, so start dates, breaks, workdays, and makeup rules may differ across school systems.
relatedDistrictsDescription: Compare school-year dates across other North Carolina districts.

relatedDistricts.name: Wake County Public School System
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Wake County publishes traditional and year-round calendars with dates that differ from CMS. Confirm the assigned calendar before coordinating plans between the two districts.

relatedDistricts.name: Guilford County Schools
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Guilford County uses its own start dates, breaks, workdays, and makeup rules. Compare the same school year directly when coordinating schedules.

relatedDistricts.name: Cumberland County Schools
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Cumberland County Schools serves Fayetteville and communities around Fort Liberty. Its calendar starts substantially earlier than CMS in 2026–27, so families moving between the districts should compare start and end dates carefully.
